title: sphaeradenia horrida

This plant is traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, alleviating pain, and improving digestive health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
